about: Variants code has that the Figma set lacks, usually because a screen needed them first. The other direction of gaps.json (compose skill): there, a screen needs what neither Figma nor code has; here, code already has it and Figma must catch up. Storybook → Guides → Figma sync → Code ahead of Figma lists every row with its status, where screens use it (found from `usage`: a component and prop, optionally a value, in src/features) and two screenshots. Status: open (only in code) · in-figma (designer added it, sync not run yet) · done (the sync lists it in the registry; keep the row as history, with `closed` and `resolution`). `images` pairs the Figma set today (<id>-figma.png, from get_screenshot on the set or the closest variant) with what code renders (<id>-code.png, from capture-standin.mjs on its story), both under references/code-ahead/. `num` is the row's old number in figma-audit.md, kept so older notes still resolve.

items.title: Sidebar item: second line and per-item menu
items.code: `meta` (a second line under the label, e.g. a timestamp) and `actions` (a per-item menu beside the link, shown on hover and focus) for chat or file history.
items.proposal: Add `Type = With meta` (two-line label) and a `Show actions` boolean with a trailing ghost icon Button (visible in Hover/Active) to the Navigation list item set.

items.title: Dropdown item: Danger colour
items.code: `color="danger"`: a destructive item (Delete) with `text-fg-danger-strong` text and icon and a `bg-danger-soft` hover.
items.proposal: Add a `Color = Default / Danger` property to the Dropdown list item set.
items.resolution: Figma `Color = Default / Danger` on the Dropdown list item set (Default type).

items.title: Chat bubble: fluid width
items.code: `width="fluid"`: the bubble fills up to 80% of the conversation width (full-page chat) instead of Figma's 320px.
items.proposal: Add a `Width = Fixed / Fluid` property to the Bubble set (Fluid = fill container, max 80%).
items.resolution: Figma `Width = Fixed / Fluid` on the Chat bubble and Bubble sets.

items.title: Navbar: fluid width
items.code: `fluid`: the content row runs full width (`px-4`, no `max-w-screen-xl`) for app shells.
items.proposal: Add a `Width = Contained / Fluid` property to the Navbar set.
items.resolution: Figma `Width = Contained / Fluid` on the Navbar set (Desktop variants).

items.title: Navbar: compact size
items.code: `size="compact"`: the bar uses `py-1` (44px tall with `sm` logo and action controls) for dense app shells.
items.proposal: Add a `Size = Default / Compact` property to the Navbar set with the compact padding.
items.resolution: Figma `Size = Default / Compact` on the Navbar set (Desktop variants).
